about: compiler/cmd/nativebuild: CLI and end-to-end checked+lowered-to-archive driver. Each row breaks a fail-closed admission or diagnostic check.

mutants.name: nativebuild-fallible-sig-accepted
mutants.rule: Functions with non-empty failure or capability rows are refused before native ABI emission even when the body never invokes fail.

mutants.name: nativebuild-diags-ignored
mutants.rule: Unchecked or ill-typed packages with type diagnostics are rejected before lowering.

mutants.name: nativebuild-root-imports-dropped
mutants.from: let rootImports = if bind.Imports(d.K.Files).Len() == 0 { option.Some[[]expr.Dep]{Value: []expr.Dep{}} } else { rootImportsFor(p, at, available) }
mutants.rule: Packages resolve rootImports from loaded imports so lowering has complete rewrite scope.

mutants.name: nativebuild-stop1-local-records-dropped
mutants.rule: Unit builds collect local declared record schemas so struct types and fields lower.

mutants.name: nativebuild-stop1-imported-records-dropped
mutants.rule: Dependency ImportUnit exports its declared record schemas so dependent packages resolve imported struct types and fields.
